entries.description: String. Substitutes %1, %2, … (numbered from one) into the template. %% is a percent sign. A placeholder with no argument is empty. StrTemplate("%1-%2", "ab", 7) is ab-7.
String. Joins the string form of each array element. The separator is optional and empty when omitted. A value that is not an array is refused.
Boolean. True when the string starts with the search text. The comparison ignores case. An empty search matches.
Boolean. True when the string ends with the search text. The comparison ignores case. An empty search matches.
